title: Romanize
summary: RO'MANIZE, verb transitive 1. To latinize; to fill with Latin words or modes of speech. 2. To convert to the Roman catholic religion, or to papistical opinions. RO'MANIZE, verb intransitive To conform

inlines.v: RO'MANIZE, verb transitive 1. To latinize; to fill with Latin words or modes of speech. 2. To convert to the Roman catholic religion, or to papistical opinions. RO'MANIZE, verb intransitive To conform to Romish opinions, customs or modes of speech.
